name: APW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Brandon Charm through most of 1997, contested repeatedly by American Patriot; vacant for Anarchy In The UK III; won by Mondo Somatic in the WrestleStock '97 Day 3 finale, and Chris Douglas is billed as champion by King Of The Hill II.

name: APW Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Mondo Somatic across 1997; lost and regained across the fed's own late-year cards, most recently on Wednesday Night Chaos, 15 October 1997.

name: APW Unified British Commonwealth-North American Championship
epitaph: A merged title, its constituent belts seen separately in March 1997 and unified by June; held by 62nd Assassin as of Anarchy In The UK III.

name: APW Bruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Contested only on pay-per-view in gimmick matches; held by Smasher through mid-1997, taken by Mumonkan on Wednesday Night Chaos, 15 October 1997, via Smasher's own interference against the defending Psycho.

name: APW EXTREME Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a 17-man Battle EXTREME at the fed's own rename event, Anarchy In The UK II; held by Supernova into mid-1997.

name: APW Lightweight Championship
epitaph: Added to the fed's slate by August 1997 for wrestlers 210 lb and under; contested in a tournament reaching its later rounds by WrestleStock '97.

name: APW Six-Man Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Iron Sultan & Cosmic Connection's own trio into mid-1997, defended against Masters of Havoc's Psycho & Scary Nights.

name: APW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Unforgiven and later Destroyers across 1997; Dr. Doom & Masked Bulldog billed as champions by King Of The Hill II.

name: APW North American Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Destruction into April 1997; The Syndicate wins the titles on WrestleStock '97 Day 1.

name: APW International Championship
epitaph: A new title in the fed's second era; first champion Brandon Charm, named on-air at Christmas Carnage.

name: APW Cruiserweight Title (denied)
epitaph: Explicitly and honestly denied by the fed's own founder: "no Cruiserweight title" -- recorded because acronym-cousin feds do carry one, and the fed's own negative is itself a fact worth keeping.
